name: Myanmar
summary: Junta airstrikes kill at least 15 civilians in Rakhine and Karenni; Arakan Army presses Sittwe
state: Military airstrikes killed at least 15 civilians, 12 of them in Rakhine State, including a strike on a maternity clinic and a school, Sowetan reported on 2 Nov (also Anadolu). France 24 reported on 5 Nov that civilians remain under heavy fire. The Arakan Army has advanced to the edge of Sittwe, but no major city had changed hands as of 6 Nov.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice, which advises against travel to much of Myanmar.
rubric_hit: Watch: civil war at sustained intensity; no major city fallen

sources.title: Anadolu — Myanmar military airstrikes kill at least 15 civilians, including 12 in Rakhine

why: A multi-sided civil war affecting 50 million people, with spillover to China, Thailand, India and Bangladesh.
drivers: Resistance offensives, junta airstrikes, Chinese mediation, elections, humanitarian access.

rubric.alert: Major city falls, mass-casualty airstrikes, or cross-border escalation.
